title: parcel.created
description: Published by S2 Parcel & Pricing once per new booking (not for idempotent replays). Kafka topic parcel.created, key = parcel id (aggregateId). Delivery is at-least-once; consumers de-duplicate on eventId. Contains no names, phone numbers, addresses or user ids.

source.description: How the parcel was created. CUSTOMER_BOOKING is published today; MERCHANT_ORDER is reserved for merchant orders.
